race.comment: BOUDICA WARRIOR (11) ran a bold race over this journey last start, racing on the pace and sticking on strongly to finish 0.8 lengths away in second at Tatura, which followed a third placing first up. Clearly come back well, stays right down in the weights and has the coveted inside alley. Conversely, BRING THE THUNDER (1) has 60kg but has put together a body of work that profile well for this sort of race. Hasn't been beaten far the past four runs and will again be around the mark. BRONCO REVOLUTION (7) finished just behind stablemate BOUDICA WARRIOR last start, so if that is the right form then she's got to be given a chance. FOXIET (6) had done little before the maiden win last start and while she was put away after that, she's trialled well since and gets a gun draw. EL SALTO (5) was below his best last time, finishing eighth and beaten 3.5 lengths over 1000m at Ballarat but looks better suited here and can feature again.
